recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes to this extension should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack, not by duplicating the moved definition in the core FHIR checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-28539 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core issue asking for a boolean type-must-support extension to identify which polymorphic types and Reference/canonical target profiles are must-support, with usage notes for mustSupport elements.
initial_application: Git history shows the extension was added to the core ElementDefinition extension spreadsheet in 7dc631890e and the FHIR-28539 usage-note and requirements text was applied in 996427bf69. Commit dd468d4f17 later removed R5 extension definitions from core source as part of the extension-source migration.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes confirm the 2020-09-14 14-0-0 persuasive vote. The linked Zulip thread clarified that the extension should also apply directly to ElementDefinition.type for polymorphic choice types, and later package-scope discussion led to tooling/extension package availability rather than reintroducing the definition in core.
reconciliation: No core source files were changed. The active FHIR Extension Pack definition for elementdefinition-type-must-support has ElementDefinition.type, ElementDefinition.type.profile, and ElementDefinition.type.targetProfile contexts, a mandatory boolean value, and the substantive FHIR-28539 usage-note guidance; core retains only the canonical OID assignment.
